2026 · As captain

The unbeaten treble

Trinity went through the 2026 domestic season unbeaten, winning every major title on offer with Althaf as skipper.

Dialog Schools Rugby Knockout

President's Trophy

58–26v Royal

Hat-trick and 3 conversions in the final. Trinity's first knockout title in fifteen years.

Dialog Schools Rugby League

League Champions

20–7v St Peter's

Title retained unbeaten. Althaf named Player of the Tournament.

80th Bradby Shield

Bradby Shield

72–20aggregate

39–10 in the second leg at Pallekele. 15 points (try, 2 conversions, 2 penalties) and Player of the Match.

2023 – 2026

Career record

Four seasons in the Trinity 1st XV, moving from emerging fly-half to vice-captain to captain of the most successful side in the school's recent history.

2026Captain

President's Trophy winner

Beat Royal 58–26 in the knockout final. Hat-trick and three conversions.

League champion, unbeaten

Retained the Dialog Schools Rugby League with a 20–7 win over St Peter's. Player of the Tournament.

80th Bradby Shield

Player of the Match in both legs. Bradby won 72–20 on aggregate to seal the treble.

2025Vice-captain

League title after 38 years

Clinched the league against Wesley 23–21 with a conversion, a penalty and a 43m drop goal.

Knockout semi-final

60m try plus conversions and a penalty against Zahira. Swisstek Player of the Match.

Rugby Lion

Awarded his Lion for 2025 and named captain for 2026.

2024Breakthrough

78th Bradby, 1st leg

12 of Trinity's 17 points in a 17–16 win, including a 38m drop goal, and a cross-kick for a try.

78th Bradby, 2nd leg

53m penalty. Trinity won the Bradby Shield for the first time in a decade. NDB Player of the Match.

Sri Lanka U18 Sevens

Initially selected for the national U18 Sevens squad; later replaced due to injury.

2023Senior debut

1st XV debut at fly-half

Five conversions, a penalty and tactical 50:22s in a 55–10 win over Science College. NDB Player of the Match.

U16 vice-captain

Unbeaten U16 side that won the All Island Invitation Sevens, the Simithrarachchi Trophy and the Tens championship.

Scouting view

His game

A back-three playmaker with specialist kicking value and proven captaincy in one of Sri Lanka's most competitive school rugby environments.

Goal-kicking

Range and composure

Long-range penalties and drop goals in Bradby legs and title deciders, from 38m out to 53m. The kicks that decided his biggest games came under the most pressure.

Territory

Tactical kicking

50:22s on senior debut, cross-kicks for tries and a kicking game used to control territory at 10 and 15.

Distribution

Playmaker

Set up the 2024 Bradby try with a cross-kick; drew the last defender to put Amher Faizal over in the 2026 decider.

Ball in hand

Counter-attack

60m try against Zahira, a hat-trick in the President's Trophy final and a try in the Bradby second leg.

Leadership

Captain

Vice-captain in 2025, captain in 2026. Led an unbeaten domestic season and three trophies.

Big games

Temperament

Player of the Match awards in the 2023 league, the 2024 and 2026 Bradby, and the 2025 knockouts.

All-round athlete

Multi-sport

Football and athletics background, including a goal in Trinity's 2–0 football win over Royal in 2024.

Individual awards and team titles from his four seasons in the 1st XV.

Shan Althaf is the 2026 captain of Trinity College Kandy 1st XV rugby, a fullback / fly-half and specialist goal-kicker whose record includes decisive Bradby Shield performances, the 2025 and 2026 league titles, and leadership of Trinity's unbeaten 2026 treble.
